prompt: Extract this saved HTML pattern article into the library.
setup: A writable checkout contains the library with tags through S14.
The full main article teaches a reusable pattern, with mechanisms and deep dives but no seniority labels.
Navigation, player controls, a quiz, and reader comments surround the article.
A probe file for the article’s pattern already contains cited probes from an earlier source.
expected: Read the complete main article locally without requiring a web tool.
Create or extend a cohesive pattern reference with S15 citations, supported tradeoffs, and unanswered gaps.
Derive symptom probes with cited technical criteria while explicitly recording no seniority bar.
Exclude page chrome, quizzes, reader comments, and linked walkthroughs; update the index.
Extend probes/<pattern>.md without a source-number prefix, continue after the highest existing probe number, and preserve source tags inside citations.
must_not: Treat a deep-dive heading as a senior or staff expectation.
Mine linked walkthroughs or executable script data.
Copy the raw saved page or account UI into the plugin.
Create a second probe file for the same pattern solely because the source tag differs, or renumber existing probes.
